title: Source change blocks
responsibility: Splits source into named functions/methods and remainder blocks with line bounds, fingerprints and decision counts.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.code
inputs.description: Complete source text passed to the splitter. The function dispatches this full string by language and imposes no explicit size limit.

inputs.name: sourceBlocks.language
inputs.description: Selects the splitting branch. "ts" is treated as one script region, "svelte" emits script blocks, a template remainder, and at most the first style remainder, and every other SourceLanguage value emits one module remainder.

outputs.name: sourceBlocks
outputs.description: Returns a module remainder and any named script blocks; Svelte additionally returns a template remainder and the first style remainder when present. Each block reports its kind, source line bounds, a 16-character SHA-256 fingerprint, and complexity.
